shortDescription.text: Default capabilities: some containers do not drop all

fullDescription.text: The container should drop all default capabilities and add only those that are needed for its execution.

help.text:

Type: Kubernetes Security Check
Severity: LOW
Check: Default capabilities: some containers do not drop all
Message: Container 'backend' of Deployment 'backend-clean' should add 'ALL' to 'securityContext.capabilities.drop'
Link: [KSV-0003](https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/ksv-0003)
The container should drop all default capabilities and add only those that are needed for its execution.

shortDescription.text: Root file system is not read-only

fullDescription.text: An immutable root file system prevents applications from writing to their local disk. This can limit intrusions, as attackers will not be able to tamper with the file system or write foreign executables to disk.

help.text:
Misconfiguration KSV-0014
Type: Kubernetes Security Check
Severity: HIGH
Check: Root file system is not read-only
Message: Container 'backend' of Deployment 'backend-clean' should set 'securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem' to true
Link: [KSV-0014](https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/ksv-0014)
An immutable root file system prevents applications from writing to their local disk. This can limit intrusions, as attackers will not be able to tamper with the file system or write foreign executables to disk.

fullDescription.text: Security context controls the allocation of security parameters for the pod/container/volume, ensuring the appropriate level of protection. Relying on default security context may expose vulnerabilities to potential attacks that rely on privileged access.

help.text:
Misconfiguration KSV-0118
Type: Kubernetes Security Check
Severity: HIGH
Check: Default security context configured
Message: deployment backend-clean in default namespace is using the default security context, which allows root privileges
Link: [KSV-0118](https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/ksv-0118)
Security context controls the allocation of security parameters for the pod/container/volume, ensuring the appropriate level of protection. Relying on default security context may expose vulnerabilities to potential attacks that rely on privileged access.
